content:
- Model consistently overestimates prices in early days of the forecast horizon, especially after recent spikes.
- Underestimates prices during sharp downward trends, particularly when true values dip below 70.
- Overreacts to short-term volatility; forecasts overshoot after spikes and fail to correct quickly.
- Shows persistent bias toward higher values in the first 5–10 days of the forecast window.
- Mean reversion is underappreciated; model fails to recognize that prices often return to prior range after extreme moves.
- Tends to ignore recent low values in history when forecasting, leading to underestimation of subsequent lows.
- Forecast horizon 30d is overly optimistic; model fails to account for seasonal or policy-driven downward pressure in later days.
